items.headline: Gale Warning issued October 16 at 7:52PM EDT until October 20 at 2:00AM EDT by NWS Charleston SC
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Small Craft Advisory, northwest winds 15 to 25
kt with gusts up to 30 kt expected. For the Gale Warning,
north winds 25 to 35 kt with gusts up to 40 kt and seas 7 to
10 ft expected.

* WHERE...South Santee River SC to Altamaha Sound GA out 20 NM.

* WHEN...For the Small Craft Advisory, from 6 AM to noon EDT
Saturday. For the Gale Warning, from noon Saturday to 2 AM EDT
Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for hazardous conditions.
